description: This file defines CRUD operations for routines related to the smart light control system, acting as a service layer interfacing with the database module.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all routines associated with a specific user.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new routine for a specific user with provided data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a specific routine by its ID for a given user.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing routine identified by routineId for the specified user.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a routine identified by routineId for the specified user.
